name: Seaside Overflow
source:
After quitting your depressing corporate job, you decide to pursue your dream career: becoming an Outuber. Unfortunately, with mediocre looks and barely any talent, your videos barely attract audiences. However, that changes when a starving merfolk breaks into your house and steals your unfinished spicy hotpot that made your stomach perform a catastrophic rendition of Bohemian Rhapsody in the toilet. Now, how will you handle this crazy situation?
